context: Evaluates whether the agent applies Rule 3's resolving-direction check: promoting a revealed risk to risk-register before deleting the tech-debt row that surfaced it.

checklist.name: Checks for revealed risk before deleting
checklist.description: Agent explicitly applies Rule 3 and identifies the flaky/uncovered test suite as a real risk

checklist.name: Does not delete silently
checklist.description: Does not immediately delete row #1 without the check

checklist.name: Promotes to risk-register
checklist.description: A new docs/RISK_REGISTER.md row is added or explicitly recommended for the flaky/uncovered test suite

checklist.name: Cross-references by name
checklist.description: The new risk-register row references tech-debt item #1 by name so the discovery isn't lost

checklist.name: Row #1 deleted, not marked Resolved
checklist.description: docs/TECH_DEBT.md row #1 is deleted entirely -- no Resolved status invented

checklist.name: Explains the two-step reasoning
checklist.description: Agent tells the user why a second doc got a new row, not just silently doing more than asked

checklist.name: No append-only invented
checklist.description: Does not add append-only machinery to tech-debt itself

checklist.name: Ordering correct
checklist.description: Risk-register row added before (or atomically with) tech-debt row deletion, not after

checklist.name: Names the specific finding
checklist.description: Describes the flaky/uncovered fixture-file test suite concretely, not vaguely

checklist.name: Validation still run
checklist.description: Still runs or mentions validate-tech-debt-schema.sh for whatever tech-debt edit remains
